Name: Yūnangii (Okinawan home cooking)
Search: ゆうなんぎい 那覇市久茂地
Notes: Local favorite for rafute, goya champuru and jimami tofu. Expect a line.

Name: Jack's Steak House
Japanese name: ジャッキーステーキハウス
Search: ジャッキーステーキハウス 那覇市西
Notes: Postwar American steak diner, open since 1953.

Name: Shuri Soba
Search: 首里そば 那覇市首里赤田町
Notes: Simple, much-loved Okinawa soba near Shuri Castle. Lunch only.

Name: Makishi Public Market
Search: 第一牧志公設市場 那覇市松尾
Notes: Pick fish downstairs and have it cooked upstairs. Fun for kids to look at the colorful fish.

Name: Kokusai-dōri Yatai Village (food stalls)
Search: 国際通り屋台村 那覇市牧志
Notes: Lane of small stalls with Okinawan dishes from all over the islands. Casual, lively and easy with kids.

Name: Ōjima Island tempura
Search: 奥武島 天ぷら 南城市玉城奥武
Notes: Tiny island joined by a short bridge. Cheap fried-fish tempura from takeout stands, and lots of cats.

Name: Uchinā Chaya Bukubuku (foam tea)
Japanese name: うちな～茶屋 ぶくぶく
Search: うちな～茶屋 ぶくぶく 那覇市首里
Notes: Traditional tea whipped into a tall foam hat. Kids find it funny.

Name: Hamaya (Okinawa soba)
Search: 浜屋 中頭郡北谷町北谷
Notes: Seaside soba shack near the American Village.

Name: Transit Café
Search: トランジットカフェ 中頭郡北谷町宮城
Notes: Ocean-view café on the Sunabe seawall. Good at sunset.

Name: Gordie's (burgers)
Search: ゴーディーズ 中頭郡北谷町砂辺
Notes: Classic American burgers by the seawall.

Name: Zooton's (burgers)
Search: ズートンズ 中頭郡北谷町
Notes: Popular burger spot near American Village.

Name: A&W Makiminato
Search: A&W 牧港店 浦添市牧港
Notes: The original Okinawa A&W drive-in. Root beer refills.

Name: Blue Seal Makiminato (ice cream)
Japanese name: ブルーシール 牧港本店
Search: ブルーシール 牧港本店 浦添市牧港
Notes: Flagship of Okinawa's ice cream brand. Try beni-imo (purple sweet potato).

Name: Jimmy's Ōyama (bakery & café)
Search: ジミー 大山店 宜野湾市大山
Notes: American-style cakes, pies and a deli since 1956.

Name: Charlie's Tacos
Search: チャーリー多幸寿 沖縄市中央
Notes: Old-school Koza taco shop.

Name: King Tacos (birthplace of taco rice)
Japanese name: キングタコス 金武本店
Search: キングタコス 金武本店 国頭郡金武町金武
Notes: Taco rice was invented in Kin. A good stop on the way north.

Name: Kishimoto Shokudō (soba)
Search: 岸本食堂 国頭郡本部町渡久地
Notes: Century-old soba shop. Pair with the Churaumi Aquarium.

Name: Okinawa Churaumi Aquarium
Search: 沖縄美ら海水族館 国頭郡本部町石川
Notes: Whale sharks in one of the world's biggest tanks. Free dolphin shows in Ocean Expo Park outside. Plan a full day.

Name: Okinawa Zoo & Museum (Kodomo no Kuni)
Search: 沖縄こどもの国 沖縄市胡屋
Notes: Zoo with local animals plus a hands-on kids' science hall.

Name: Bios Hill
Search: ビオスの丘 うるま市石川嘉手苅
Notes: Jungle boat ride, goats, water-buffalo cart, and a big lawn for running around.

Name: Okinawa World
Search: おきなわワールド 南城市玉城前川
Notes: Huge Gyokusendo cave walk, eisa drum show, glass and bingata workshops.

Name: DMM Kariyushi Aquarium
Search: DMMかりゆし水族館 豊見城市豊崎
Notes: Modern indoor aquarium inside iias mall. Good on a rainy day.

Name: Neo Park Okinawa
Search: ネオパークオキナワ 名護市名護
Notes: Walk-through bird and animal zoo with a little train.

Name: Okinawa Prefectural Museum (kids' room)
Japanese name: 沖縄県立博物館・美術館
Search: 沖縄県立博物館・美術館 那覇市おもろまち
Notes: Hands-on discovery room for kids plus island history.

Name: Busena Marine Park (underwater observatory)
Search: ブセナ海中公園 名護市喜瀬
Notes: Walk down a pier into an underwater observation tower and see reef fish without getting wet. Glass-bottom boat too. A good Blue Cave alternative for little kids.

Name: Onna Blue Cave (Cape Maeda)
Japanese name: 青の洞窟 真栄田岬
Search: 青の洞窟 真栄田岬 国頭郡恩納村真栄田
Notes: Glowing blue sea cave. A snorkel tour is the classic way in. Some take kids from 2–4 years old with a parent, and boat-only peeks also run. Winter waves close it often. The cliff viewpoint is free.

Name: Ryukyu Mura (cultural village)
Search: 琉球村 国頭郡恩納村山田
Notes: Old Okinawan houses, eisa dance parades, buffalo sugar press and craft workshops. Very kid-friendly.

Name: Nago Pineapple Park
Japanese name: ナゴパイナップルパーク
Search: ナゴパイナップルパーク 名護市為又
Notes: Self-driving pineapple carts through a tropical garden, plus pineapple treats. Silly and fun for a 5-year-old.

Name: Okinawa Fruits Land
Search: OKINAWAフルーツらんど 名護市為又
Notes: Small indoor fruit garden and bird and butterfly house. Next to Pineapple Park and Neo Park.

Name: Southeast Botanical Gardens
Search: 東南植物楽園 沖縄市知花
Notes: Huge tropical garden with capybaras, a petting area and a little train. Night illuminations in winter.

Name: Araha Beach Park (pirate ship)
Search: アラハビーチ 中頭郡北谷町北谷
Notes: Big pirate-ship playground right on the sand, 5 minutes from the hotel.

Name: Urasoe Daikōen (long roller slide)
Search: 浦添大公園 浦添市伊祖
Notes: Huge roller slides and climbing nets.

Name: Okinawa Prefectural Athletic Park
Search: 沖縄県総合運動公園 沖縄市比屋根
Notes: One of the biggest playgrounds on the island, plus a beach.

Name: Ginowan Seaside Park
Search: 宜野湾海浜公園 宜野湾市真志喜
Notes: Playground next to Tropical Beach.

Name: Peace Memorial Park playground
Japanese name: 平和祈念公園 子供広場
Search: 平和祈念公園 子供広場 糸満市摩文仁
Notes: Giant slides and play equipment inside the peace park. One parent can play while the other visits the museum.

Name: Junglia Okinawa (theme park)
Search: ジャングリア沖縄 名護市
Notes: Jungle adventure park, opened 2025. Some rides have height limits, so check them for a 5-year-old before buying tickets.

Name: Araha Beach
Search: アラハビーチ 中頭郡北谷町北谷
Notes: Calm, family-friendly beach with the pirate-ship playground.

Name: Sunset Beach
Search: サンセットビーチ 中頭郡北谷町美浜
Notes: Right at American Village. Shallow water and sunsets.

Name: Tropical Beach
Search: トロピカルビーチ 宜野湾市真志喜
Notes: Groomed city beach with showers and a park.

Name: Churasun Beach
Search: 美らSUNビーチ 豊見城市豊崎
Notes: Big man-made beach near the airport and outlet mall.

Name: Emerald Beach
Search: エメラルドビーチ 国頭郡本部町石川
Notes: Clear water next to Churaumi. Bring swimsuits on aquarium day.

Name: Ikei Beach
Search: 伊計ビーチ うるま市与那城伊計
Notes: Reached by the Kaichū-dōro sea road. Clear and quiet.

Name: Naminoue Beach
Search: 波の上ビーチ 那覇市若狭
Notes: Naha's only beach, below a clifftop shrine.

Name: Mībaru Beach (glass-bottom boat)
Search: 新原ビーチ 南城市玉城百名
Notes: Natural beach with rock pools at low tide and short glass-bottom boat rides.

Name: Azama Sun Sun Beach
Japanese name: あざまサンサンビーチ
Search: あざまサンサンビーチ 南城市知念安座真
Notes: Calm family beach with a playground and showers. Ferry port to Kudaka Island next door.

Name: Moon Beach
Search: ムーンビーチ 国頭郡恩納村前兼久
Notes: Crescent-shaped, calm resort beach. Day visitors can use it for a fee.

Name: Sunabe Seawall
Japanese name: 砂辺 シーウォール
Search: 砂辺 シーウォール 中頭郡北谷町砂辺
Notes: Flat seawall walk with murals, cafés and sunsets. Stroller-friendly.

Name: Shuri Kinjō-chō stone path
Search: 首里金城町石畳道 那覇市首里金城町
Notes: Old cobbled lane under huge trees, down the hill from the castle. About 15 minutes.

Name: Nakagusuku Castle ruins
Search: 中城城跡 中頭郡北中城村大城
Notes: UNESCO castle with curving stone walls and wide lawns. Easy loop with big views.

Name: Sēfa-utaki (sacred grove)
Search: 斎場御嶽 南城市知念久手堅
Notes: Short forest walk to Okinawa's holiest site. Wear sneakers.

Name: Hiji Falls
Search: 比地大滝 国頭郡国頭村比地
Notes: About 40 minutes each way on stairs and a suspension bridge. Doable for an active 5-year-old. Far north.

Name: Bise Fukugi Tree Road
Search: 備瀬のフクギ並木 国頭郡本部町備瀬
Notes: Shady sand lanes under 300-year-old trees in an old village, 5 minutes from Churaumi. Rent bikes or ride a buffalo cart.

Name: Shikinaen Royal Garden
Search: 識名園 那覇市真地
Notes: UNESCO royal villa with a pond, stone bridges and an easy loop path.

Name: Fukushūen (Chinese garden)
Search: 福州園 那覇市久米
Notes: Walled garden with a waterfall, koi pond and pagoda, right in the city. A calm half hour.

Name: Gangala Valley
Search: ガンガラーの谷 南城市玉城前川
Notes: Guided 80-minute walk through a jungle valley of caves and banyan trees. Booking required, and kids are welcome. Across from Okinawa World.

Name: Chinen Cape Park
Search: 知念岬公園 南城市知念久手堅
Notes: Short path out to a grassy headland with big ocean views. Next to Sēfa-utaki.

Name: Cape Zanpa
Search: 残波岬 中頭郡読谷村宇座
Notes: Cliff walk, lighthouse you can climb, and a giant shisa statue.

Name: Murasaki Mura (craft village)
Search: 体験王国むら咲むら 中頭郡読谷村高志保
Notes: Over 100 hands-on crafts: shisa painting, glass, bingata dyeing, sanshin. Very kid-friendly.

Name: Yachimun no Sato (pottery village)
Search: やちむんの里 中頭郡読谷村座喜味
Notes: Working pottery studios and a big climbing kiln. Great for buying dishes.

Name: Tsuboya Yachimun Street & Pottery Museum
Search: 壺屋やちむん通り 那覇市壺屋
Notes: Old stone-paved pottery street with workshops. The museum is small and good.

Name: Ryukyu Glass Village
Search: 琉球ガラス村 糸満市福地
Notes: Make your own glass cup with help from staff. Check the minimum age.

Name: Shisa painting near American Village
Japanese name: シーサー 色付け 体験 北谷
Search: シーサー 色付け 体験 北谷 中頭郡北谷町
Notes: Several shops let kids paint their own shisa lion-dog, about 1 hour.

Name: Kokusai-dōri
Search: 国際通り 那覇市牧志
Notes: Mile-long main street of souvenirs, snacks and shops.

Name: Heiwa-dōri covered arcades
Search: 平和通り商店街 那覇市牧志
Notes: Maze of covered market streets off Kokusai-dōri. Very local.

Name: Mihama American Village & Depot Island
Japanese name: 美浜アメリカンビレッジ
Search: 美浜アメリカンビレッジ 中頭郡北谷町美浜
Notes: Colorful shops, cafés and seaside boardwalk next to your hotel.

Name: Umikaji Terrace, Senagajima
Japanese name: 瀬長島ウミカジテラス
Search: 瀬長島ウミカジテラス 豊見城市瀬長
Notes: White terraces of shops and food stalls, with planes landing overhead.

Name: Koza Gate Street
Search: ゲート通り 沖縄市上地
Notes: Street outside Kadena's gate with surplus shops, tailors and bars.

Name: AEON Mall Okinawa Rycom
Japanese name: イオンモール沖縄ライカム
Search: イオンモール沖縄ライカム 中頭郡北中城村ライカム
Address (JP): 中頭郡北中城村ライカム1
Notes: Biggest mall on the island. Has an aquarium tank, food court and kids' play zone.

Name: San-A Hamby Town
Japanese name: サンエーハンビータウン
Search: サンエーハンビータウン 中頭郡北谷町北前
Notes: Close to the hotel, with a supermarket and kids' clothing.

Name: San-A Urasoe West Coast PARCO CITY
Japanese name: サンエー浦添西海岸 PARCO CITY
Search: サンエー浦添西海岸 PARCO CITY 浦添市西洲
Notes: Large seaside mall with a rooftop play area.

Name: San-A Naha Main Place
Japanese name: サンエー那覇メインプレイス
Search: サンエー那覇メインプレイス 那覇市おもろまち
Notes: Big central Naha mall.

Name: Ashibinaa Outlet Mall
Japanese name: 沖縄アウトレットモール あしびなー
Search: 沖縄アウトレットモール あしびなー 豊見城市豊崎
Notes: Brand outlets 15 minutes from the airport. Good last stop before flying.

Name: iias Okinawa Toyosaki
Search: イーアス沖縄豊崎 豊見城市豊崎
Notes: Mall with the Kariyushi aquarium and kids' indoor play.

Name: Koza Gate Street surplus shops
Japanese name: ゲート通り ミリタリーショップ
Search: ゲート通り ミリタリーショップ 沖縄市上地
Notes: Military surplus, vintage American clothes, patches.

Name: Vintage clothing, American Village
Japanese name: 古着 北谷 美浜
Search: 古着 北谷 美浜 中頭郡北谷町美浜
Notes: Several vintage and used clothing shops in the village. Open the map search for the current list.

Name: 2nd Street (used clothes & goods)
Japanese name: セカンドストリート 北谷
Search: セカンドストリート 北谷 中頭郡北谷町
Notes: Big Japanese resale chain. Kids' clothes and toys are cheap. Several branches nearby.

Name: Hard Off / Off House (used goods)
Japanese name: ハードオフ オフハウス 宜野湾
Search: ハードオフ オフハウス 宜野湾 宜野湾市
Notes: Used electronics, toys, homeware and clothes. Treasure-hunt fun.

Name: Shuri Castle
Search: 首里城 那覇市首里金城町
Notes: Seat of the old Ryukyu kings. Reconstruction after the 2019 fire, so check what's open.

Name: Tamaudun (royal mausoleum)
Search: 玉陵 那覇市首里金城町
Notes: UNESCO stone tombs of the Ryukyu kings, a few minutes' walk from Shuri Castle.

Name: Nakijin Castle ruins
Search: 今帰仁城跡 国頭郡今帰仁村今泊
Notes: Long curving castle walls on a hilltop with sea views. Easy to add to a Churaumi day.

Name: Naminoue Shrine
Search: 波上宮 那覇市若狭
Notes: Clifftop shrine above the sea.

Name: Zakimi Castle ruins
Search: 座喜味城跡 中頭郡読谷村座喜味
Notes: Graceful stone walls you can walk on top of. Usually quiet.

Name: Cape Manzamo
Search: 万座毛 国頭郡恩納村恩納
Notes: Elephant-trunk cliff and a short loop path.

Name: Kaichū-dōro sea road
Search: 海中道路 うるま市与那城
Notes: Drive across the sea to small islands with old villages and beaches.

Name: Senagajima plane-spotting
Search: 瀬長島 豊見城市瀬長
Notes: Planes land right over your head. Kids love it.

Name: Peace Memorial Park & Museum
Japanese name: 沖縄県平和祈念資料館
Search: 沖縄県平和祈念資料館 糸満市摩文仁
Notes: Where the Battle of Okinawa ended. Names of over 240,000 dead on stone walls. Museum is heavy, but the park itself is fine for kids. [heavy for kids]

Name: Himeyuri Peace Museum
Japanese name: ひめゆり平和祈念資料館
Search: ひめゆり平和祈念資料館 糸満市伊原
Notes: Story of the schoolgirl nurse corps. Very moving. [heavy for kids]

Name: Former Japanese Navy Underground HQ
Search: 旧海軍司令部壕 豊見城市豊見城
Notes: Tunnels dug into the hill, with shrapnel marks on the walls. [heavy for kids]

Name: Tsushima Maru Memorial Museum
Search: 対馬丸記念館 那覇市若狭
Notes: About the 1944 sinking of an evacuation ship full of children. [heavy for kids]

Name: Kakazu Takadai Park
Search: 嘉数高台公園 宜野湾市嘉数
Notes: Battle site with pillboxes and a lookout tower over Futenma air base. Has a playground too.

Name: Maeda Escarpment (Hacksaw Ridge)
Search: 前田高地 浦添市仲間
Notes: The ridge from the film. Walk from the Urasoe Castle ruins.

Name: Michi-no-Eki Kadena
Search: 道の駅かでな 中頭郡嘉手納町屋良
Notes: Rooftop deck overlooking Kadena Air Base and a small museum. Kids like watching the jets.

Name: Okinawa City History Museum (Hi-Story)
Search: ヒストリート 沖縄市中央
Notes: Photos of postwar Koza and life alongside the US bases.

Name: Chibichiri-gama cave
Search: チビチリガマ 中頭郡読谷村波平
Notes: Cave where civilians died in 1945. A memorial site. View from outside only and be respectful. [heavy for kids]

Name: Eisa drum show at Okinawa World
Japanese name: おきなわワールド エイサー
Search: おきなわワールド エイサー 南城市玉城前川
Notes: Loud, energetic dance show that kids usually love.

Name: Kouri Island bridge
Search: 古宇利大橋 国頭郡今帰仁村古宇利
Address (JP): 国頭郡今帰仁村古宇利
Notes: Drive the long bridge over turquoise water. Easy add-on to Churaumi day.

Name: Okinawan folk music live houses
Search: 民謡居酒屋 那覇 那覇市
Notes: Dinner with live sanshin and audience dancing. Early shows suit kids.
